description: Lifecycle and inspection interface shared by all managed devices on the board (create, reset, suspend, resume, remove, info, operation discovery).

commands.label: Create device
commands.description: Creates a new local device instance in the target slot using its device type ID, creation flags, and packed type-specific configuration.

fields.label: Create flags
fields.description: Bit 0 (SYS_DEVICE_CREATE_SYSTEM): system device owned by the board

fields.label: Configuration
fields.description: Packed configuration structure defined by the device type

commands.label: Reset device
commands.description: Reinitializes hardware registers and driver state back to the default state configured at creation.

commands.label: Suspend device
commands.description: Puts the device into a safe low-power or stopped state and rejects non-system operations until resumed.

commands.label: Resume device
commands.description: Restores the device after suspension and resumes normal operation.

commands.label: Remove device
commands.description: Destroys the device instance, frees its slot and hardware resources. Refused for system devices or devices used by others.

commands.label: Device info
commands.description: Reads the runtime metadata of an existing device slot (type ID and suspend state).

commands.label: List operations
commands.description: Returns all remote-callable operations supported by this device along with their supported directions (LOCAL ops excluded).

returns.label: Operations
returns.description: One row per operation: the device registry ops followed by the driver ops

fields.label: Sides
fields.description: Bit 0: read supported; bit 1: write supported

commands.label: Create remote device proxy
commands.description: Creates a proxy slot for a device running on another board over a session link.

fields.label: Remote board
fields.description: Session peer board ID owning the hardware device

fields.label: Remote device ID
fields.description: Device slot ID on the remote board

fields.label: Link flags
fields.description: Exactly one SYS_DEVICE_REMOTE_* transport mode flag

events.label: Device suspended
events.description: The device entered the suspended state.

events.label: Device reset
events.description: The device was reset to its configured defaults.

events.label: Device created
events.description: A new device instance was created in this slot.

events.label: Device removed
events.description: The device instance was removed from this slot.
